_comment: Every gate declares whether it is LIVE. A live gate must find at least
min_subjects things to inspect; a dormant gate must find exactly zero. That
second half is the important one: it means the day phase 4 lands a tool
registry, the tool-honesty gate stops being dormant BY FAILING, and someone
has to flip live:true deliberately. A dormant gate that silently reports
green is v1's `ctest -E realmodel` -- a selector that matched nothing while
printing a number that looked fine.
Exemptions are by path, and every one carries a reason. There is no
wildcard-with-no-explanation entry, and adding one should be as awkward as

protocol.note: protocol/schema.json does not exist yet. S4.4: generated TS and C++ are regenerated and diffed; drift fails.

tool_honesty.note: No tool registry yet. S6.3: any tool name a description or error string mentions must resolve to a registered tool. v1 audited this once and 7 of 13 tools were lying.

prose_correctives.note: No loop yet. S9.2: the count of prose-only corrective sites must be 0. v1 had 11 of 34, including one named ForceWrite that forced nothing.

size_exempt.reason: Ported verbatim from v1 (S18). These are the falsifiers; reformatting evidence to satisfy a line limit makes it no longer the thing that was measured. bakeoff/log_triage/generate_corpus.py is 1125 lines and stays that way.

dead_code_exempt.reason: The production Clock. Referenced only from main() in the sidecar, which does not exist until phase 4; tests use ManualClock. Remove this entry when the sidecar lands.
The replay side of the byte-faithful trace pair (S2.1.4). Its only non-test caller is ReplayBackend, phase 2. Kept because shipping an encoder with no decoder is how a trace stops being replayable.
